Resolves #21257

The Portal's Medium tab now opens on part 3 of the memory series, "Codebase RAG vs grep for AI coding agents: the same grep hits scored 10, 30 or 34 of 40", as entry 79 of `apps/portal/resources/data/medium_blog.json`. ITNEXT published the story the same day, so, as for entry 78 (#20737), `publisher` is "ITNEXT" and `url` is the operator's share link on itnext.io. Data only: no code, no migration.

Evidence: L3 (the card rendered in the local Portal at two widths; the story read on Medium) -> L3 required (#21257 AC-2 and AC-3).

Micro-review eligible: docs — one data entry in the existing shape, no code.
